groups.name: usb_in
groups.why: USB-C receptacle (declared south edge) with its CC1/CC2 5.1k pull-downs R10/R24 and the DNI CC-to-VBUS options R20/R22, each at its CC pin

groups.name: power
groups.why: power entry: VDC from the USB-C through Schottky D5 and polyfuse PTC1 to VBUS; NCP115 3.3 V LDO U4 (EN delayed by D6/R6/C36) and 1.2 V LDO U1 (EN = PWR_EN, SJ2 ties it to VBUS); VBUS input caps C3/C7/C9, U4 output bulk C13 and U1 output cap C37

groups.name: core
groups.why: RP2040 with its 12 MHz crystal (C1/C2 load, R1 XOUT series), its +3V3 decaps (8x0.1u + 2x4.7u for 9 supply pins) and +1V1 decaps C4/C5/C6; its QSPI boot flash U2 (back) with CS pull-up R3, USB_BOOT series R2 and decap C8; the 27R series resistors it drives: USB D+/D- R4/R5 (at the chip, the RP2040 habit), ICE_SCK R9, ICE_CLK R12, CLKOUT R23

groups.name: fpga
groups.why: iCE40UP5K with its VCCIO_0/SPI_VCCIO1 decaps C24/C28 + bulk C25, VCC core cap C27 and core jumper SJ4, bank-2 VCCIO caps C29/C30 with jumper SJ5, VPP_2V5 diode D1 + cap C31, VCCPLL RC filter R11 + C33/C34, CRESET pull-down R7, CDONE series R25 (the FPGA drives CDONE)

groups.name: fpga_mem
groups.why: the FPGA's SPI bus: config flash U8 (decap C26) and PSRAM U5 (decap C42 on its STDBY rail fed by D4), the PSRAM CS level FET Q1 with R13/R15, the SPI pull-ups/downs RN1 and R8

groups.name: leds
groups.why: RGB LED D2 with its 1k cathode resistors R17-R19 (LED_R/G/B, driven by the FPGA RGB pins and RP2040 GPIOs), anode jumper SJ1 and cap C32; CDONE LED D3 with its 2.2k pull-up R14

groups.name: btn_rst
groups.why: the RP2040 button SW1, routed by 3-way jumper J4 to RUN or ADC2, with the RUN pull-up R16 (reset RC goes with the button)

groups.name: btn_ice
groups.why: the FPGA button SW2 (declared north edge, top-actuated PTS820) with its pull-up R21 and debounce cap C14
